svg.title: AI Malware Detection System — Full Architecture & Workplan
svg.desc: A structural diagram showing all phases and components of the AI-driven malware detection system from data ingestion to the Flask dashboard.

g.text: Labelled malware samples + benign files dataset
Phase 2 — ML / Deep learning model training
